shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,160p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\" && rg \"interface Options|type Options|strictSchema|instancePath\" node_modules/ajv/lib node_modules/ajv/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -80 && git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg 'declare module .ajv|class Ajv|interface Options' src test* types* node_modules/@types -g '*.d.ts' 2>/dev/null | head -80; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,160p' tsconfig.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./package-lock.json'); console.log(p.packages['node_modules/ajv']?.version, p.packages['']?.dependencies?.ajv)\" && rg '\"node_modules/ajv\"|\"version\": \"[68]\\.' package-lock.json | head -20 && npm ls ajv --depth=0"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,80p'; test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs && echo reanchor-present || true; git diff --check; git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "fix(tools): report schema rejection paths" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
